## [1.4.1](https://github.com/toidicakhia/morphe-app-patches/compare/v1.4.0...v1.4.1) (2026-10-28)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* repair TeraBox Google login and keep Benefits ads ([aa7223e](https://github.com/toidicakhia/morphe-app-patches/commit/aa7223ee96a667561d707ac897739b19a06f73e3))

patches.name: Unlock VIP
patches.description: Forces permanent professional VIP tier, removes ads and upgrade popups, bypasses PairIP.

patches.name: Disable Analytics / Telemetry
patches.description: Disables all Cloudflare telemetry by no-oping the analytics bundle builder and the Firebase event dispatchers.

patches.name: Disable SSL Pinning
patches.description: Bypasses OkHttp certificate pinning on Cloudflare API calls to allow TLS traffic inspection.

patches.name: Spoof WARP+ Unlimited UI
patches.description: Forces WarpPlusState to UNLIMITED on every AccountData instance by intercepting the primary constructor before the account type field is written.

patches.name: Clone app
patches.description: Installs TeraBox as a separate app alongside the original, with its own account. Each copy needs a different clone number.

patches.name: Fix Google login
patches.description: Makes Sign in with Google work in the patched app, where it would otherwise fail. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Blocks feed, banner, interstitial, app-open and video player ads on every page except Benefits, where rewarded ads stay available.

patches.name: Hide consent form
patches.description: Hides the ad consent form shown at startup.

patches.name: Hide promotions
patches.description: Hides Premium upgrade cards and banners, prize and campaign cards, speed-up prompts, floating invites, and sale, coupon and promotional popups.

patches.name: Hide video recommendations
patches.description: Hides the recommended videos below the video player.

patches.name: Unlock Premium Plus
patches.description: Unlocks HD up to original quality, playback speeds up to 3x and video uploads. HD buffers faster over parallel connections.

patches.name: Bypass SSL pinning
patches.description: Bypasses EZVIZ certificate pinning and hostname checks so a debugging proxy can read its HTTPS traffic. Also trusts user-installed certificates. Not selected by default.

patches.name: Bypass Signature Check
patches.description: Skips the repack signature hash check in LoadingActivity that closes the app before it can start.

patches.name: Remove Ads
patches.description: Removes banner, splash and hot open-screen ads.
